## Critical (must fix)

1. `STOP_TIMER` in turnReducer MUST set `turn.phase = "awaitingJudgement"` (and stop timer). Spec requires this.
2. `REQUEST_JUDGE` guard: accept `phase === "awaitingJudgement"` OR also allow from `questionRunning` (host can judge without cutting timer). Best UX:
   - STOP_TIMER → awaitingJudgement
   - Host can also REQUEST_JUDGE from questionRunning (optional cut) OR show Correcta/Incorrecta in BOTH questionRunning and awaitingJudgement
3. HostScreen: ensure Correcta/Incorrecta are visible when phase is `questionRunning` OR `awaitingJudgement`. After STOP_TIMER, user must be able to click them.
4. Add reducer test: START_QUESTION → STOP_TIMER → phase is awaitingJudgement → REQUEST_JUDGE → CONFIRM_JUDGE works.
5. Add reducer test: CONFIRM_JUDGE incorrect leaves score unchanged (+0).

## Important (fix in same pass)

6. `RESTART_TIMER`: force `phase = "questionRunning"`; allow from `questionRunning` OR `awaitingJudgement` (prórroga). Show Reiniciar timer button in awaitingJudgement too on HostScreen.
7. `ABORT_TURN_RESPIN`: only allow from `questionRunning` or `awaitingJudgement` (allow-list), not from reveal/showScores.

## Verify
npm test && npm run build — all green

## Report
Append to .superpowers/sdd/fase-c-final-fix-report.md with commit SHA and test results.

Return Status, commit, tests (<15 lines).
